title: Tour X Solid
lines: For the cover, we have chosen a solid version of the cover used on the Tour X. Our DR-4 Solid veneer allows the Tour X Solid to read the mid-lane stronger than its pearl counterpart.
When the lanes get tough, smart bowlers get Tour X Solid!
Finish | 500 / 3000 Abralon® with Power House Factory Finish Polish
Lane Condition | Medium To Light Oil
